reflection: RC evidence wording is provenance, not an exact-card identity key.
English color words matching player surnames must not create parallel labels.
Generic jersey cutouts are memorabilia but are not automatically patches.
Cross-year season, color parallel and explicit serial fractions need stronger priority.
Non-basketball leakage must be marked source_error.

reflection: Exact-card memorization did not generalize across mostly unique players/cards.
Adjacent-season errors caused by copyright/release-year ambiguity remain the largest addressable Top-3 gap.
Product-scoped parallel knowledge is more reusable than whole-card memorization.
Machine metrics remain training diagnostics and are not acceptance proof.

reflection: Parallel identity and season ambiguity remain the largest reusable recognition gaps.
Serial numbering errors increased and should be separated into OCR misses versus checklist misses.
Waiting for all 100 predictions before source-assisted labeling wastes wall-clock time without improving blind-test integrity.
Incremental labeling is safe only when current-batch labels are excluded from every prediction job in that batch.

reflection: v4.9 did not generalize: Top-1 and Top-3 fell to 36.08% and 37.11% on a zero-overlap batch.
Parallel errors were dominated by taxonomy pollution: product logos and finish words were stored as parallel names instead of canonical colors.
Machine truth itself used inconsistent full-finish versus color-only parallel names, invalidating earlier cross-batch comparisons.
Strict season and exact-card identity remain major unsolved errors; no unvalidated retrieval heuristic was promoted.
Long collection requests exposed retry idempotency and concurrent top-up races.

reflection: Batch 10 achieved the strongest Top-1 and Top-3 machine-assisted diagnostics among batches 7 through 10.
Parallel errors mixed insert-name leakage, product logos, color mistakes and source-label ambiguity; no single broad rewrite was safe.
The final batch therefore retained image-v5.3.0 instead of promoting an unvalidated heuristic.
